name: Figaro DAO
description: The commons' treasury, met through its operator account — an EOA carrying an EIP-7702 delegation to governance-controlled code. The multisig vault authorizes each procurement upstream and supplies its tokens. The vault, not this profile's wallet, registers figaro-commerce and the clauses the DAO develops, and claims their designer rewards. An identity today; the buyer side (procurement through bonded processes) and the seller side (merchandise, co-produced data) follow on this same profile.
